summary: Read Array length as a JavaScript Number.

target.notes: For the canonical JsArray representation this can be a direct C# property read converted to double. A List<T>.Count fast path is valid only if analysis proves Count equals JavaScript length.

caveats: Do not use the count of materialized elements for sparse arrays; JavaScript length includes holes.

tests.name: sparse length counts holes
tests.notes: Length counts holes even though no indexed elements are materialized.
